ns2:section.sectionText: Overnight field trip required: April 16 & 17 [Note the change in the field trip dates which was originally scheduled for April 23 & 24]. A $55 field field trip fee (non-waived) will be assessed to student's bill. Students will also be responsible for paying for their lodging (one night) at the time of the trip. Questions may be directed to the instructor (fschlipf@illinois.edu). Be sure to enroll in your desired amount of credit hours (2 or 4 hours) for this variable credit course.
